answer: Every identity keeps a mirror of its verified work in a crystal-clear public ledger, one fresh task per epoch, each linked to the one before. Each epoch a zephyr, a random unpredictable audit, sweeps a few identities and demands one past task be re-derived live from public records. An honest agent does one task per epoch and re-derives it cheaply. A fake must fabricate a whole consistent mirrored history per identity, each link costing full work, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand full histories and the flood fails.
